selection: First selected larger real project with TS semantic support: date-fns release 4.1.0. Three newly authored feature requests chosen before any model outcomes. No benchmark shopping or task replacement. Internal confirmation on a real repository, not SWE-bench or population certification.

tasks.instruction:
Add optional fractionDigits?: 0 | 3 to FormatISOOptions and formatISO. Default 0 must preserve current output. With 3, append exactly three local milliseconds digits after seconds and before the timezone, in complete and time representations and both basic and extended formats. Date-only output must not include fractions. Reject any provided value other than numeric 0 or 3 with RangeError, including for date-only output. Preserve Invalid Date errors, date construction context, timezone behavior and input immutability. Modify only src/formatISO/index.ts.
Run npm test -- --maxWorkers=1 --minWorkers=1 --pool=forks src/format/test.ts src/lightFormat/test.ts src/formatISO/test.ts src/formatDuration/test.ts and npm run types after your last source edit. Keep all existing tests, dependencies, package manifests, generated files and unrelated behavior unchanged. Only change the specified implementation files. Do not retrieve published solutions, reference patches or benchmark verifier source. Work independently from this checkout.

Add optional maxUnits?: number to FormatDurationOptions and formatDuration. When omitted, preserve current behavior. Accept only finite nonnegative integers; reject all other provided values with RangeError, including with an empty duration. Zero returns an empty string. Positive values limit the number of actually emitted unit strings, after existing format order, missing-unit exclusion and zero handling, before joining with the existing delimiter. Preserve custom/default locale selection, explicit format ordering, input/options immutability and every other behavior. Modify only src/formatDuration/index.ts.
Run npm test -- --maxWorkers=1 --minWorkers=1 --pool=forks src/format/test.ts src/lightFormat/test.ts src/formatISO/test.ts src/formatDuration/test.ts and npm run types after your last source edit. Keep all existing tests, dependencies, package manifests, generated files and unrelated behavior unchanged. Only change the specified implementation files. Do not retrieve published solutions, reference patches or benchmark verifier source. Work independently from this checkout.

Add a project-specific J token to both format and lightFormat using the existing shared formatter tables. J emits local wall-clock milliseconds since midnight, computed from local hours, minutes, seconds and milliseconds; it must not use UTC fields or elapsed real milliseconds since the start of day. JJ and any longer repeated J token emit that integer padded with leading zeros to at least eight digits. Implement the calculation once in the light formatter table and delegate to it from the general formatter table. Preserve quoted literals, other tokens, locales, dates and public function signatures. This is an explicit project extension, not a claim of Unicode-standard conformance; parsing is outside scope. Modify only src/_lib/format/lightFormatters/index.ts and src/_lib/format/formatters/index.ts.
Run npm test -- --maxWorkers=1 --minWorkers=1 --pool=forks src/format/test.ts src/lightFormat/test.ts src/formatISO/test.ts src/formatDuration/test.ts and npm run types after your last source edit. Keep all existing tests, dependencies, package manifests, generated files and unrelated behavior unchanged. Only change the specified implementation files. Do not retrieve published solutions, reference patches or benchmark verifier source. Work independently from this checkout.

Identical complete tracked source per arm and shared read-only-by-instruction dependency installation; no artificial large-file padding. Provider cache/nondeterminism uncontrolled.
quality: Record official runtime completion separately from independently executed existing tests, independently held-out feature behavior, audited request compliance and no solution retrieval. Required selected tests and types must actually succeed after last edit in agent trace; grader reruns cannot replace agent proof. Full 250-file suite is also rerun by independent grader. Retain all failures/timeouts/unexecuted and missing consumption. Manual SHA-bound trace/final source review required before audited completion.
accounting: Input+output tokens without double counting cache/reasoning; per-request aggregate reconciliation, cache completeness separate. Estimated API cost is not invoice. Runner and outer, preparation and verifier durations separate. Report whole panel lower bounds and task-matched audited-completion plus reconciled consumption pairs; task-cluster uncertainty with only three clusters is exploratory. Compare modified/reference, modified/native and reference/native; no pooling with earlier campaigns.
mechanism: Inspect symbol/range/raw reads, returned-source bytes, repeated contextual exposure and model requests. Tool description is an exposure, not a causal benefit. Count accepted no-ops, layout corrections, blocked edits and unchanged loop stops. Larger source size alone does not prove token savings.
decision: Retain T5 only with actual mechanism recovery, compatible quality on known layout diagnostics and fresh real-project tasks, and no scope/validation regression. A favorable model sample cannot establish universal noninferiority or no remaining margin. Publish negative/inconclusive native comparisons unchanged.
